description: The expanded question's verified presence (zerus-a4mub.12, completeness zerus-a4mub.27); Android QuestionPresencePolicies and ZerusKit QuestionPresencePolicies both check every row.

cases: the expanded identity (null: nothing expanded, no view), the projection's questions, verified (the projection came from a verified frame), available (the verified frame accepts answers), checking (a refresh is in flight), checked_ago_ms (null: never checked) and complete (pending_questions_complete; omitted means an older CLI and counts as complete).

expect: the view, or null. modal true only for a resolved card (answerable or waiting); every obsolete state is an inline notice so an unrelated delivery review stays reachable. replacement_hash names the newer request's hash. A card is answerable only from a verified projection carrying the exact question; cache, age, Working and an incomplete scan never enable it, close it or replace it.
ages and reasons: the check-age text and the mapped native input::checked_terminal veto; a raw veto never reaches the person.
